senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="O01707">same</cite> <cite ref="Bava Batra 61b:12">B. Bath. 61ᵇ</cite> <he>אי אמר ליה ארעתא ס׳</he> if he said to him, fields (I sell thee), without any further qualification.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 81b:6">B. Mets. 81ᵇ</cite> <he>הנח ס׳</he> ‘put it down’ without anything else (instead of <he>הנח לפני</he> or <he>הנח לפניך</he>); <he>הא ס׳ ולא כלום</he> from which we deduce that if he said merely, ‘put it down’, he has said nothing. Ib. 15ᵃ, a. fr. <he>ס׳ דמילתא</he> ordinarily.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 4a:12">B. Bath. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>הא ס׳ אין מחייבין אותו</he> but where there is no distinct usage in that respect, we do not force him; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Yevamot 42b:11">Yeb. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>ס׳ דמתניתן ומחלוקת וכ׳</he> if the Mishnah states an opinion anonymously (as undisputed), and the Boraitha records differences; <he>ס׳ בברייתא וכ׳</he> where the Boraitha states an undisputed opinion; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 157a:3">Sabb. 157ᵃ</cite> <he>ר״י ס׳ אחרינא אשכח</he> R. J. found another ruling opinion of R. S. without having his name attached to it.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 4:3:1">Y. Bets. IV, 62ᶜ</cite> bot. <cite ref="O01687"><he>סְתוּמָה</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="O01705"><he>סָתַם</he></cite>.
